id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataLoadMountPath.description:
Path to FileSystem.mounts['data-load']. Used when interacting with uploaded files
for {@link FileSourceCollection}s

rootPkg.description: Needed to construct a {@link Pkg.Path} will creating external types

persistableKeywords.description: Used to sanitize typeMetas that mix Persistable and ensure selfServiceDI generates valid {@link TypeMetas}

persistableSchemaNames.description:
The schema names corresponding to the system columns that cannot be used from {@link Persistable} and {@link Meta}
Used to sanitize typeMeta schemaNames and ensure selfServiceDI generates valid {@link TypeMetas}.

reservedTypeNames.description:
Used to validate user configured types to ensure there are no collisions with
the existing types declared in the current package and it's dependencies e.g. platform types.

selectedSourceSystemCacheItem.description: Details about the currently selected source system cache item in the tree view.

selectedSourceCollectionCacheItem.description: Details about the currently selected source collection cache item in the tree view.

selectedDataSourcePreviewTypeMeta.description: The type metadata for the current selection when previewing a data source in the landing page.

selectedDataSource.description: The selected data source, currently used for selecting a data source to delete.

schemaTabInlineNotification.description: Used by multiple conditional renderers to decide which error inline notification to render

selectedTableSchemaCacheItem.description: Details about the currently selected source collection's table schema cache item.

deletedSourceFiles.description:
The Deleted {@link SourceFile}s. Used to filter out the Target Preview Grid for {@link FileSourceCollection}
The keys are the sourceCollectionNames and the values are the sourceFileIds that have been deleted from them.

expressionEngineFunctions.description: The expression engine functions available in an application. used for providing suggestion and validating transforms

dataConnectorsConnectionConfiguration.description:
Data connector connection configuration properties and fields to render the connection form for data connectors
Stored as map to enable fast lookups while preserving property ordering

fileSystemsMountsOptions.description:
File Systems Mounts Options with key as (SelfServiceDI.UI.DataConnector storageKind)
value as array of string with corresponding mounts options

dataConnectorConfigFormData.description: Properties stored with values for Data Connector Config form

title: Application state for storing self-service DI related information
